title: Each census and factdiff item check selects its own test, not one combined test whose id carries six selectors
goal: census_retry, census_baseline, census_repin, census_github_page, factdiff_learn_git and factdiff_anchor each select a test that exercises only that item's behaviour, within the test ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json (raise it with the operator's gate if the ceiling is what forces the merge), so a passing check proves its own item.
